title: Recall complete match arms
summary: Reconstruct each complete arm from memory, using the qualified variant, the arrow and the specified string literal. Surrounding code and tests remain hidden until the round ends. Apply accepts a complete implementation checked in your local environment.

waiting.clue: Write the full match arm for Job’s Waiting variant returning the string "waiting"; omit the separating comma.

ready.clue: Write the full match arm for Job’s Ready variant returning the string "ready"; omit the separating comma.
